main.summary: Provides transfer artifacts and publication-journal operations for DataControl publish workflows.

method.name: LoadSegmentedManifestAsync
method.summary: Loads the segmented transfer manifest for a session.
method.returns: The segmented manifest, or null when unavailable.

method.name: LoadJournalsForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Loads all publication journals for the specified catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journals.
method.returns: Matching persisted journal states without loading tenant payloads.

method.name: DeleteJournalsForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Deletes all publication journals for the specified catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journals.
method.returns: True when one or more journals were removed.

method.name: LoadStreamManifestAsync
method.summary: Loads the stream transfer manifest for a session.
method.returns: The stream manifest, or null when unavailable.

method.name: ReadObjectPayloadAsync
method.summary: Reads the serialized object payload for a session.
method.returns: The object payload, or null when unavailable.

method.name: OpenObjectAsync
method.summary: Opens the serialized object payload for a session.
method.returns: The object payload stream, or null when unavailable.

method.name: OpenSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Opens a composed stream over a realized segmented range.
method.returns: The composed range stream, or null when the range is not fully realized.

method.name: OpenStreamRangeAsync
method.summary: Opens a composed stream over realized stream chunks.
method.returns: The composed range stream, or null when the range is not fully realized.

method.name: RecomputeIntegrityAsync
method.summary: Computes integrity from the session’s persisted segment evidence.
method.returns: Computed integrity, or null when the session or evidence is unavailable.

method.name: LoadIntegritySegmentsAsync
method.summary: Loads ordered integrity segment evidence for a session.
method.returns: Ordered evidence, or null for an unsupported or missing session.

method.name: LoadObjectReferenceAsync
method.summary: Loads the persisted object reference for a transfer session.
method.returns: The tenant storage object reference, or null when the session or object reference is unavailable.

method.name: CreateSegmentedBlockPlanAsync
method.summary: Creates a deterministic storage block plan from the persisted segmented ranges of a session.
method.returns: The segmented block plan, or null when the session is unavailable or is not segmented.

method.name: CreateStreamBlockPlanAsync
method.summary: Creates a deterministic storage block plan from the persisted stream chunks of a session.
method.returns: The stream block plan, or null when the session is unavailable or is not a stream transfer.

method.name: LoadRecoverableCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded page of lightweight publication journal candidates for recovery.
method.param: Inclusive update-time cutoff for the scan.
Exclusive keyset cursor from the previous page, if any.
Maximum number of candidates to return.

method.name: LoadJournalAsync
method.summary: Loads one publication journal belonging to the specified catalog.
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.
method.returns: The journal, or null when unavailable.

method.name: GetOrCreateJournalAsync
method.summary: Loads or creates a publication journal in the catalog declared by the supplied journal.

method.name: AdvanceJournalAsync
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.

method.name: RecordJournalFailureAsync
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.

method.name: DeleteJournalAsync
method.returns: A task representing the deletion operation.
